Investing.com -- stock surged 18.5% to trade at €29.10 after French defence and aerospace group announced it had entered exclusive negotiations to acquire a 51.6% controlling stake in the Breton laser specialist from entities controlled by CEO and majority shareholder Marc Le Flohic, at a proposed price of €30.10 per share.

# Lumibird Shares Surge After Thales Targets Majority Stake in $483 Million Laser Deal
Published on 11/27/2026 at 03:52 am EST
Dow Jones
By Adam Whittaker
Shares in laser-technology company Lumibird soared after Thales said it was in exclusive talks to buy a majority stake that would value its photonics division at around 440 million euros, including debt, equivalent to $482.6 million.
In opening European trade, shares were 18.5% higher at 29.1 euros, lifting their year-to-date gains to 37%.

Investing.com -- Thales (EPA: TCFP) has entered exclusive negotiations to acquire a 51.6% stake in Lumibird, held by entities controlled by the laser technology group’s CEO and majority shareholder, Marc Le Flohic, the French defence company said on Friday.

The proposed price values Lumibird at €30.10 per share, a 24.7% premium to its one-month volume-weighted average share price of €24.15 before the announcement. Additional payments of up to €2.56 per share, mainly linked to a medical earn-out, could take the price to €32.66 if all conditions are met.

The deal values Lumibird’s photonics division at around €440 million, equivalent to about 23 times its 2027 consensus EBIT.

The acquisition is expected to follow the disposal of Lumibird’s Medical division, which is due to close by the end of 2026. The stake acquisition is expected to close in the second quarter of 2027, subject to the disposal and regulatory clearances.

Lumibird’s board unanimously welcomed the transaction. Final agreements are expected after consultation with employee representative bodies at both companies.
